reconcile.note: Gill reads the sundial sign as confirming Hezekiah's whole promise at once, healing, added years, and Jerusalem's deliverance together, not two rival purposes.

discrepancy.emptyNote: 2 Kings 20:8 has Hezekiah ask for a sign confirming his healing, while Isaiah 38:6 gives the sign to confirm a different promise, deliverance of the city from Assyria.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Editorial statement of the mechanism; catalogued by Steve Wells, The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (contra/sundial.html) (2013).

sides.snippet: Hezekiah said to Isaiah, What shall be the sign that Yahweh will heal me, and that I shall go up to the house of Yahweh the third day?
sides.verseText: Hezekiah said to Isaiah, What shall be the sign that Yahweh will heal me, and that I shall go up to the house of Yahweh the third day?

sides.snippet: I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city.
sides.verseText: I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city.
